title: PD-TxBench Phase 2 gold + rubric file
description: Schema for tasks/pdtx/gold/<task_id>.json — combines the gold answer and the scoring rubric for one task.

preferred_decision.description: The decision a strong answer should reach. Go/No-Go/Conditional Go for therapy tasks; Supported/Partially supported/Unsupported/Contradicted for evidence tasks.

acceptable_decisions.description: Other decisions that are still defensible (partial credit on the decision criterion).

required_concepts.description: Concepts a strong answer must engage with.

acceptable_variants.description: Synonyms / alternative phrasings that count as covering a required concept.

red_flags.description: Failure modes that should be penalized if present (e.g. overclaiming, ignoring BBB/toxicity).
